decisions.reason: The drink mix builds on the firm's established nutrient-from-biomass knowledge and benefits from its in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.
As a modular extension of the existing waste-to-energy line, it is close to the firm's core knowledge and supported by R&D cooperation.
Waste oil to energy is directly related to the firm's established waste-to-energy technologies and its dedicated web page indicates commitment.
Plastic waste to fuel is close to the firm's existing waste-to-fuel activities and its absorptive capacity allows learning from early market results.
